newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore property index falls 2.5 pct in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Singapore property index falls 2.5 pct in Q4.

text.p: Singapore's overall property price index fell 2.5 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996, compared with a 1.7 percent fall in the third quarter, the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Friday.
The property price index rose 4.9 percent for the full year against an 11.3 percent rise in 1995, the URA said in a statement.
Private residential property prices rose by 5.0 percent for the whole of 1996, against a 10.3 percent rise in 1995.
For the fourth quarter, residential property prices fell by 2.7 percent against a 2.0 percent decline the previous quarter.
Prices of landed residential properties fell by 4.4 percent while non-landed property prices fell by 1.0 percent in the fourth quarter.
Commercial property prices slipped 2.0 percent compared with a 0.6 percent rise in the previous quarter.
Prices of office space fell 1.8 percent while prices for shop space were down 2.1 percent.
Industrial property prices fell 0.5 percent compared with a 2.4 percent increase in the third quarter.
